Precondition: Config Tool open at Item Master Container Config section for a finished good
Expected Result: Config is saved with trays per container, parts per tray, serialized flag, dunnage code, and customer code

Precondition: A finished good with a saved container config
Step: Reopen the item and review the container config
Expected Result: Fields persist and are the values that drive automatic container lifecycle management on the shop floor

Precondition: A non-serialized finished good's container config
Step: Set the ClosureMethod and review the derived capacity
Expected Result: ClosureMethod is selectable (ByCount / ByWeight / ByVision); container capacity resolves to TraysPerContainer x PartsPerTray (capped by Item.MaxParts if set)

Precondition: Two configs — one serialized line, one non-serialized
Step: Compare how each is configured for closure
Expected Result: Serialized config closes by part count via the MIP handshake; non-serialized config is two-stage (tray validates per ClosureMethod, container count increments per tray pass)

Step: On the shop floor, attempt to scan pieces into a location that would exceed MaxParts for that item
Expected Result: Scan-in is rejected when total pieces of the item across all non-Closed LOTs at the location plus the incoming count would exceed MaxParts

Precondition: A Cell with a LinesideLimit LocationAttribute set
Step: On the shop floor, attempt a scan-in that would exceed the Cell's total-piece limit
Expected Result: Scan-in is rejected when current lineside pieces across all items plus the incoming quantity would exceed LinesideLimit
Notes: LinesideLimit set via Plant Hierarchy attribute; enforcement is shop-floor

Precondition: A finished good with a container config (PartsPerTray set)
Step: Create/edit a work order with a target quantity not evenly divisible by the tray quantity
Expected Result: Non-divisible target is rejected with a specific error; at WO Close a non-divisible good count is blocked unless a supervisor overrides via AD elevation (reason logged)
Notes: Work Orders CONDITIONAL; validates against ContainerConfig
